rv.q: I suspect we will be toasting this production ages hence too.
As an opportunity to see two actors at the very top of their considerable game, its unmissable; even if the play itself is, at times, a frustrating enigma.
The menace goes missing and for any Pinter, but especially this, that’s fatal.

While not quite attaining the Olympian heights of their illustrious predecessors, Stewart and McKellen spar like veterans, drawing out the humour and the pathos from characters who are drowning in their own mortality.

cn.t: McKellen and Stewart prove unmissable in Pinter's enigmatic power struggle, though the cryptic 1975 play teeters between brilliance and obscurity. Critics largely embrace this pairing of theatre knights tackling a fragile masterpiece.
